A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we give polynomial-time algorithms for the problem of minimizing the mean flow time with an error constraint when the ready times are identical, and we show that the general problem is NP-hard even if the ready times are the same for all tasks.

the optimal schedule problem for the imprecise computation model is solvable in polynomial time if all the tasks have similarly ordered ready times and deadlines (i.e., either all ready times and deadlines are identical or they are similarly ordered), and oppositely (or similarly) ordered mandatory execution times (i. e., either all tasks have the same mandatory execution time, or all tasks have oppositely (similarly) ordered mandatory execution time and total execution time).
The main takeaway from our work is that
it provides a first step in the direction of understanding the complexity of scheduling imprecise computation tasks.
